page.layout: One printed page (right) with a running head and page number at the top, one text column in the centre, a narrow column of marginal marks at the right of the text, and a signature and catchword below the text. The left edge of the neighbouring page is not transcribed.

main_text.p: «««««««««««««nia): Ingens, inquit, terror astrictus est, quasi diceretur, Si te non revocat à cæde hominis, quòd ejusdem tibi naturæ est, si adeò totus animo sceleratus & impius es, ut fraternum fœdus violare pro nihilo habeas, omnemque com-passionem & sensum humanitatis ex-veris: cogita, quòd ad imaginem Dei factus est, & quantis eum Deus dignatus sit prærogativis;& quod omnis creaturæ dominatu atque imperio dignatus sit: & hæc cogitatio à tam immani proposito te cohibebit. Quibus mihi adjicere liceat; si Principis statuam deturbans aut confringens, severè puniatur, quanto magis diffipans vivum il-lud atq; intelligens Dei simulachrum, in cujus compage omnium creaturarum flores & eminentias, tam mirabili unione ipse naturæ sator colligauit? quòd tantum brutis præstat animantibus figura corporis, majestate vultus, temperie carnis,&præsertim activitate mentis; quantum ipsa bruta animantia inanimatis, truncis & lapidibus. Uni-cum ego primi homicidæ horrendum spectaculum, in scenam proferam: de

page.notes: The column of marks at the right of the text is thirteen printed «-marks, one beside each of the first thirteen lines; each is shown as a note, but they are placed together at the start of the paragraph rather than beside their exact lines. Doubtful: the printed "ex-ueris" was read as "ex-veris" under the u/v rule. The printer's forms "ipfe", "fator", "fcenam" and "fpectaculum" were corrected to ipse, sator, scenam and spectaculum under the long-s rule. "Vnicum" was read as Unicum, since the initial letter is a vowel. Catchword "eo" and signature "B 2" are at the foot.
